RESOURCE CENTER
From Service to Success—EMU Has Your Back
Welcome to the Lt. Col. Charles S. Kettles Military and Veteran Services Resource Center at Eastern Michigan University. Named in honor of EMU alumnus and Medal of Honor recipient Lt. Col. Charles S. Kettles, our center is dedicated to helping veterans, active-duty service members, and military-connected students navigate the transition to higher education.
Consistently ranked a Military Friendly® school, EMU is built to fast-track your success from day one. Our team provides personalized, step-by-step guidance on maximizing your VA education benefits and GI Bill® certification, while offering the dedicated academic advising, career preparation, and community support you need to turn your military experience into a powerful civilian career.
Unlock Your Future with VA Educational Benefits at EMU
At Eastern Michigan University, VA educational benefits provide veterans, service members, and their families with powerful financial support to achieve their academic and career goals. Through programs like the Post‑9/11 GI Bill®, eligible students can have tuition and fees paid directly to EMU, while also receiving monthly housing allowances and funds for books and supplies to reduce out‑of‑pocket costs. With dedicated School Certifying Officials guiding students through the certification and enrollment process, EMU ensures a smooth experience so veterans can focus on their education and future success.
